reuse.why: Uses the existing getBudgetableCategories selection, getSheetValue, setBudget, batchMessages and the mutator(undoable(...)) registration pattern; only the income/tracking guard and sign flip are written inline rather than shared.

duplication.why: Re-states the `is_income === 1 && !isTrackingBudget()` guard and the expense sign inversion that already appear inline in the other month-wide actions, adding another copy of each.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts beside the other month-wide actions and is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: Loosens the unrelated BudgetData.goal_def type from `string | null` to optional `unknown`, an edit the feature does not need.

maintainability.why: Small and readable action that follows the sibling pattern, but a future change to the income rule or sign convention must again be made in one more place.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Category selection goes through getBudgetableCategories as the other bulk actions do.

disguised_duplication.where: setLastMonthSpending: the expense sign inversion is reshaped as `cat.is_income === 1 ? spending : -spending` instead of the `if (is_income === 0) avg *= -1` used in set3MonthAvg/setNMonthAvg; the income guard is copied verbatim.
